ios.desc:
Speaking too fast? Too many "ums"? Sounding monotone? Public speaking is difficult, and these are issues so many people struggle with.

SpeakUp shows you how you come across and helps you improve. Whether it's a job interview, a client pitch, or a big presentation, SpeakUp helps you show up at your best.

How?
	•	Feedback: Get detailed feedback on pace, filler words, and tone, broken down moment by moment.
        •	Track Progress: Watch your delivery improve session over session.
	•	Privacy First: All audio data is deleted after viewing feedback, and data is never sold to third parties. 

It’s normal to be afraid of public speaking, but it doesn’t have to stay that way.

quotes.text:
I used to HATE public speaking.

But then I joined debate, and through the constant cycle of practicing, messing up in front of everyone, and getting feedback, I improved to the point where I was winning debate competitions.

Most people never get the kind of feedback I got through debate.

So I built SpeakUp, an iOS app that does it for you. The idea is simple. Every day you get a 1-minute question (either on interviews, everyday conversations, or debate), and you record your answer. You then get feedback on things like pausing, pacing, filler words, intonation, and more! (And there are modes for further practice too!)
